verdict.rationale: PayPal provides building blocks for autonomous background work rather than a first-party automation feature. The agent toolkit lets developers build custom agents that handle payment workflows and "let AI handle repetitive tasks" across orders, refunds, disputes and shipments. Durable webhooks (up to 25 retries over 3 days) give event triggers, and Store Sync lets agents complete purchases on customers' behalf, but the user must assemble and host the automation themselves, and the toolkit docs advise keeping human oversight. Missing for 10: a native automation/scheduling builder, documented always-on background execution hosted by PayPal, examples of end-to-end autonomous workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
